name: Poojaben Patel
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: I believe the most effective therapy happens when you feel heard, respected, and actively involved in your own care. You know yourself better than anyone else, and my role is to work alongside you, helping you understand patterns, build practical skills, and move towards the life you want using evidence-based approaches tailored to your goals. Through Accessible Psychology, I provide Australia-wide telehealth, increasing access to quality mental health care for people in remote communities and for those who find face-to-face appointments difficult, overwhelming, or impractical.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery

name: Kate Hands
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Kate is an experienced counsellor and wellbeing consultant who specialises in working with young people aged 12-25. Possessing a Bachelor of Applied Social Science (Counselling), a Graduate Diploma in Adolescent Health & Wellbeing from the University of Melbourne and a Graduate Certificate in Developmental Trauma, Kate has also completed numerous short courses in mental health, suicide intervention, CBT, ACT, Single Session, MI and NBT. A trauma informed practitioner, Kate utilise a range of modalities to provide therapeutic counselling, risk reduction counselling & family counselling.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Rebecca Carver
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I have been in private practice for more than 5 years treating a wide range of issues including: eating disorders, family violence, sexual abuse, depression and anxiety, grief, loss, relationship issues. I have experience working with children and adolescents and i am a practicing art therapist as well. My practice is in the inner north of Melbourne.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: At My Right 2 Voice we provide a number of services to the disability community. We specialise in psychosocial disabilities. As a counsellor and psychotherapist, I work with clients to support them to meet their well-being goals.

name: Lindy Spanger
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Lindy Spanger is a Soul Centred registered Clinical Psychotherapist and PACFA accredited Supervisor, brining over two decades of private practice experience to her work. Lindy’s clinical orientation is Soul Centred, and trauma informed, grounded in depth Psychotherapy and a profound engagement with soul and psyche. As part of her work Lindy uses EMDR, tapping, focusing and mindfulness techniques to support her clients with big life issues and Traumatic life events as well as complex trauma offering them Lifelong tools that support a sense of well-being and change. She has taught the three-year Psychotherapy training in soul centred psychotherapy and regularly facilitates Professional development workshops that teach practioners how to use the latest techniques in trauma.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Colleen Reilly
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I have specialist training in couple and relationship therapy and am passionate about working with couples. As an impartial and caring third party in the therapy room I facilitate bringing difficult issues into an open, safe and supportive environment. I work with couples who: - desire better communication and relationship satisfaction - are wishing to develop and expand their emotional and sexual intimacy - want to feel more supported by one another and align their goals in life and relationship - wish to explore issues before committing to living together, marriage , or starting a family - have parenting issues - are trying to manage conflict - are caught in unhelpful negative patterns and feeling distant and distressed, - are dealing with infidelity - are in the process of separation.
specialties: Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery
